ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
def gaussianReal (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) : Measure ℝ :=
  if v = 0 then Measure.dirac μ else volume.withDensity (gaussianPDF μ v)

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDF
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text: def gaussianPDF (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPDFReal μ v x)

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
def gaussianPDFReal (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (√(2 * π * v))⁻¹ * rexp (-(x - μ) ^ 2 / (2 * v))

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
noncomputable def hermite : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => X * hermite n - derivative (hermite n)

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: HasFDerivAt
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
def HasFDerivAt (f : E → F) (f' : E →L[𝕜] F) (x : E) :=
  HasFDerivAtFilter f f' (𝓝 x ×ˢ pure x)

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: DifferentiableAt
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
def DifferentiableAt (f : E → F) (x : E) :=
  ∃ f' : E →L[𝕜] F, HasFDerivAt f f' x

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: fderivWithin
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
irreducible_def fderivWithin (f : E → F) (s : Set E) (x : E) : E →L[𝕜] F :=
  if HasFDerivWithinAt f (0 : E →L[𝕜] F) s x
    then 0
  else if h : DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s x
    then Classical.choose h
  else 0

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: fderiv
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
irreducible_def fderiv (f : E → F) (x : E) : E →L[𝕜] F :=
  fderivWithin 𝕜 f univ x

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.name: Differentiable
exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
def Differentiable (f : E → F) :=
  ∀ x, DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x

exact_mathlib_definition_slices.exact_source_text:
irreducible_def integral {_ : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : Measure α) (f : α → G) : G :=
  if _ : CompleteSpace G then
    if hf : Integrable f μ then L1.integral (hf.toL1 f) else 0
  else 0
